# #4683: Patch: hand-hint pips name themselves on hover like field marks do
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Cards in your hand can carry small pips: a trade icon for Tradable, an altar icon with a number for Tribute. Sighted mouse players get no hover text saying what they mean, while the same mark family on field cards on phones does carry hover text. After this, hovering a pip names it ("Tradable", "Tribute", "No Trades left this turn" when dimmed).

## Why

`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` renders each pip with `aria-label` only and no `title`; `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx` sets `title={wordsOf(...)}` on the same icon family, so this is parity with existing chrome. `apps/web/src/game/handHints.ts` ships exactly two hints (Tradable, #2269/#2574 R2574000; Tribute, #2268 R2268000), so the surface is tiny. A new player meeting the altar/"2" pip has nothing in the client naming it until the play flow asks for tributes.

## Proposal

Pass each shown hint's existing translated label as the pip's `title`, and extend the hand-hint tests to hold every rendered pip to its label as hover text, including the dimmed Tradable state.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` (one attribute) and its tests (`Hand.test.tsx` / `HandHints.test.tsx` patterns); labels already come through `t()` in `handHints.ts`, so the i18n guard keeps passing with no dictionary change and no spec change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every rendered hand-hint pip carries its screen-reader label as hover text, including the dimmed state.
- [ ] Touch and screen-reader behavior unchanged; no layout or style change.
- [ ] The touched vitest files and the i18n suite pass; no new lint suppressions.

## Size and risks

Small: one attribute plus tests. Risk: none known. Rejected alternative: a visible legend row under the hand (clutters phones for two pips).
